# SpeedCE — Free Website & IP Speed Test Platform

> SpeedCE is a free online speed test tool for webmasters, developers, and network operators. Test domains, subdomains, IPv4/IPv6 addresses via six tools—HTTP, HTTPS, PING, TCPing, DNS, and Traceroute—from China provincial nodes and global nodes. Interactive maps show OK/Failed/Testing/Pending status per node. DNS and Traceroute include detailed result panels. No registration, no paywall. Official: https://www.speedce.com (Chinese default) | English: https://speedce.com/?lang=en | Contact: speedceads@gmail.com

---

## What is SpeedCE?

SpeedCE (Speed + Connectivity & Experience) helps you understand how fast and reachable your website or IP is from different regions worldwide — not just from your local network.

Unlike tools that return a single score, SpeedCE shows results on **interactive maps**: green = OK, red = failed, with real-time testing and pending states. Filter by China Telecom, Unicom, Mobile, or global regions. Select the detection tool from a **dropdown menu** on the test form.

**Target users:** personal webmasters, VPS buyers, enterprise SRE/DevOps, frontend developers, cross-border e-commerce teams.

---

## Core Features

### Detection Tools (dropdown)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| HTTP | Port 80 web availability and response time |
| HTTPS | Port 443 with SSL/TLS handshake, browser-like access |
| PING | ICMP connectivity and latency |
| TCPing | TCP port connectivity (custom port; works when ping is blocked) |
| DNS | Query DNS records from each node (domain only); types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS |
| Traceroute | Hop-by-hop route from one selected probe node; optional MTR mode for loss/latency stats |

### Node Coverage

**China nodes:** Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Sichuan, Hubei, Henan, Shandong, Fujian, Hunan, Shaanxi, Yunnan, Xinjiang, Tibet, Inner Mongolia, Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning, Guangxi, Hainan, Guizhou, Gansu, Qinghai, Ningxia, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan — with city-level points in major provinces.

**Global nodes:** USA, Canada, UK, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Switzerland, Sweden, Poland, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Australia, New Zealand, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Israel, Egypt, South Africa, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Mexico, India, Russia, Turkey, and more.

### Input Formats

- Domains: `example.com`, `api.example.com`, `a.b.example.com`
- IPv4: `1.2.3.4`
- IPv6: standard format
- DNS mode: domain names only
- Private/reserved IPs are blocked for security.

### Languages

简体中文, English, Français, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, Русский, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Español, Português, العربية, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी — via URL `?lang=xx` or UI switcher.

### Pricing

Free. No registration required. Core speed test features have no paywall.

---

## How to Use

1. Open https://www.speedce.com (Chinese default; English: https://speedce.com/?lang=en)
2. Select scope: **China nodes** or **Global nodes**
3. Select tool from dropdown: HTTP, HTTPS, PING, TCPing, DNS, or Traceroute
4. For TCPing: enter port; for DNS: choose record type; for Traceroute: select probe node (optional MTR mode)
5. Enter domain or IP
6. Click **Start Test** — watch the map update in real time
7. Filter by operator (Telecom / Unicom / Mobile) if needed

---

## Common Use Cases

- **After DNS change:** DNS + China nodes → check record consistency across provinces
- **VPS line quality:** PING + China nodes → compare Telecom/Unicom/Mobile latency
- **Ping blocked server:** TCPing + custom port → verify port is open
- **Incident response:** Screenshot map for support tickets
- **CDN verification:** Test before/after CDN switch (HTTPS + DNS)
- **Cross-border sites:** Global nodes → check overseas user experience
- **SSL deployment:** HTTPS mode → verify certificate works nationwide
- **Slow route diagnosis:** Traceroute from selected node → find bottleneck hops

---

## Map Status Legend

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| OK | Node successfully reached target |
| Failed | Timeout or connection error |
| Testing | Request in progress |
| Pending | Queued, not started yet |

Summary bar shows: total nodes, OK count, failed count, skipped, average latency.

DNS detail panel: per-node records, TTL, query time, consistency across nodes.
Traceroute detail panel: hop list, RTT, optional MTR loss/latency columns.

---

## FAQ

**Q: Is SpeedCE free?** Yes, core features are free with no registration.

**Q: Can I test subdomains and IPs?** Yes — domains, subdomains, IPv4, IPv6 (DNS mode: domains only).

**Q: What tools are available?** HTTP, HTTPS, PING, TCPing, DNS, Traceroute — select from the dropdown on the test form.

**Q: China vs Global nodes?** China = domestic provincial/operator view; Global = international cities.

**Q: How to contact?** speedceads@gmail.com | GitHub: https://github.com/freejbgo/speedce.com

## 中文摘要

SpeedCE 是免费在线网站/IP 测速平台，通过下拉菜单提供 HTTP、HTTPS、PING、TCPing、DNS、路由追踪六种检测工具，覆盖中国各省市及全球节点。输入域名或 IP 后，在中国节点地图或全球节点地图上实时查看各检测点的通畅、异常、检测中、等待状态；DNS 模式汇总各节点解析一致性，路由追踪支持 MTR 丢包统计。面向站长、VPS 玩家、企业运维、开发者与跨境电商团队。官网：https://www.speedce.com（默认简体中文），英文版：https://speedce.com/?lang=en，联系：speedceads@gmail.com
